why: B delivers the aged brown leather sofa, solid wood and black metal table, a black metal and wood shelf, black lamp and a muted earthy rug. Its dark textured cushions and black pot keep the palette cohesive. A's cognac sectional is close but not exactly what was asked, its bookcase is wrong (all-black metal shelves with a pale top, only 90 cm high), and the rust cushions and metallic planter pull away from the industrial look.
